items.title: File Klage against the rejection of the Bauantrag
items.quote: Gegen diesen Bescheid können Sie binnen eines Monats nach seiner Bekanntgabe Klage beim Bayerischen Verwaltungsgericht Musterregensburg, Haidplatz 4, 93047 Musterregensburg erheben, schriftlich oder zur Niederschrift bei der Geschäftsstelle des Gerichts.
items.computation: The letter is dated 18.11.2026 (Wednesday); assuming it was handed to the post that same day (Aufgabe zur Post), the statutory delivery fiction of Art. 41 Abs. 2 BayVwVfG ('gilt am vierten Tag nach der Aufgabe zur Post als bekannt gegeben') applies: counting the 4th day after 18.11. gives 22.11.2026, which is a Sunday. Under the established rule (analogous application of § 193 BGB) that if the fictional notification day falls on a Saturday, Sunday or public holiday the notice is deemed given on the next business day, the deemed Bekanntgabe shifts to Monday 23.11.2026. The one-month Klagefrist (§ 74 VwGO) then begins the day after Bekanntgabe (§ 187 Abs. 1 BGB), i.e. 24.11.2026, and ends, per § 188 Abs. 2 BGB, on the day of the following month bearing the same number as the Bekanntgabe day (23), i.e. 23.12.2026. That date (Wednesday) is not a Saturday, Sunday or Bavarian public holiday, so no further shift is needed. Final day to file: 23.12.2026.

warnings: The exact posting date (Aufgabe zur Post) is not stated in the letter; the Klage deadline was computed assuming the letter was posted on its printed date (18.11.2026) and using the statutory 4-day delivery fiction plus the weekend-shift rule — double-check the envelope postmark if available, as an earlier or later posting date would shift the deadline.

The 120 € fee mentioned is only a preliminary notice; the letter states a separate Kostenbescheid ('eigenen Kostenbescheid') will follow, so no payment is due from this letter alone and no payment deadline could be set.
No Widerspruchsverfahren is available in this matter per the letter ('Ein Widerspruchsverfahren ist in dieser Sache nicht vorgesehen.') — only Klage directly to the Verwaltungsgericht is possible.
